title: On Following the cart at a distance
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：follow　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 follow 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the operator ① followed the cart at a distance without complaint, and every trainee in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three shifts on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the operator ② follows the cart at a distance with great care without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ follow the cart at a distance at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ followed the cart at a distance before — a line in the log for June 1967 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Following the cart at a distance without complaint, the operator said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the switch at the far screen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ follow the stream to its source with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Follow the stream to its source at once and never mention it again.

By 1980 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the log, and a new trainee from the next station ⑧ follows the stream to its source without complaint every shift without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the screen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ followed the cart at a distance again when nobody else would.

⑩ To follow the cart at a distance, my mother said in 1985, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody follows the cart at a distance with great care again and somebody must follow the cart at a distance without complaint all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 跟随（一般过去式 followed the cart at a distance：1973 年操作员头一回这样做，毫无怨言地）
B. v. 跟随（一般现在 follows the cart at a distance：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 跟随（不定式 to follow the cart at a distance：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 跟随（过去完成时 had followed the cart at a distance：1967 年六月的运行日志上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 跟随（动名词 following the cart at a distance 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 沿…而行（follow the stream to its source：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去沿…而行顺着那条溪走到源头）
G. v. 沿…而行（follow the stream to its source：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 跟随（后段两处：新来的实习生照例 follows the stream to its source，而母亲又一次 followed the cart at a distance）

answers.why: follow 意为“跟随”，1973 年操作员毫无怨言地跟随远远跟着那辆车，那是机房里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 followed。
follow 意为“跟随”，自那以后操作员小心翼翼地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 follows。
follow 意为“跟随”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯跟随远远跟着那辆车”，此处为不定式 to follow the cart at a distance。
follow 意为“跟随”，运行日志里 六月 那行字说明早在 1980 年之前就有人跟随过，故用过去完成时 had followed。
follow 意为“跟随”，操作员说“跟随远远跟着那辆车这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 following the cart at a distance 作主语。
follow 意为“沿…而行”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去沿…而行顺着那条溪走到源头”，should ever 之后用原形 follow the stream to its source。
follow 意为“沿…而行”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻沿…而行顺着那条溪走到源头（follow the stream to its source at once），以后再也不要提起。
follow 意为“跟随”，新来的实习生每个班次都照例沿…而行顺着那条溪走到源头，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 follows。
follow 意为“跟随”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次毫无怨言地跟随远远跟着那辆车，用一般过去式 followed 叙述。
follow 意为“跟随”，结尾那句是母亲 1985 年的话：要跟随远远跟着那辆车，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和机房记住的那一件。

多年以后，操作员仍小心翼翼地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（follows the cart at a distance）

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 follow 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1973 the operator followed the cart at a distance without complaint, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the operator follows the cart at a distance with great care whenever the station asks.
Following the cart at a distance without complaint, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever follow the stream to its source with great care, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new trainee from the next station follows the stream to its source without complaint every shift, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother followed the cart at a distance again, and the station remembered that half.
